paragraphs.heading: From the customer's sketch to the finished product
paragraphs.text:

- completion and support for projects

- design of mechanical components

- design of entire systems

Since April this year, customers can call on the Workshop Platform for assistance with their design and development projects. In a short period of time, the ETH technology platform has developed into a full-service provider (FSP). Its extensive offering is primarily for all ETH researchers, who now have low-threshold, uncomplicated access to the new specialist area of design and development. The design unit works with the SolidWorks 2020 CAD system but can read and process various CAD data.

paragraphs.heading: About the Workshop Platform
paragraphs.text: “We’ll work with you to come up with a viable design idea, and then help put it into practice. Our in-depth expertise means we can implement designs, manufacture components or simply advise you on the process”, says Peter Stäuble, Workshop Platform manager. To keep this assistance cost-effective, we only charge for the items you require.

paragraphs.heading: Our expertise
paragraphs.text: Whether it’s for a design, a finished component or a consultation – the Workshop Platform team is looking forward to receiving your order! Just get in touch with us via email .

paragraphs.heading: About the Workshop Platform
paragraphs.text:
The Workshop Platform The Workshop Platform serves as the central contact and coordination point for all workshop-related matters at ETH Zurich. Our services range from personal consultations to placing manufacturing orders in affiliated and external partner workshops.

The servise service is currently in its start-up phase. Thank you for your patience in case of waiting times.
